summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Ohmyhome Ltd, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. Shareholders approved 11 routine proposals, including an increase in authorized share capital from US$7.5B to US$1T and adoption of amended memorandum and articles. No special situation—no merger, tender, or activist campaign is involved. The filing merely discloses shareholder votes on ordinary and special resolutions to authorize capital structure changes.
